name: hugo-theme-atlas
description: Documentation and Landing theme for Hugo. TypeScript + Tailwind CSS, compiled to plain CSS/JS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n CSS,TS,HUGO -c green,blue,yellow "pnpm css:watch" "pnpm ts:watch" "hugo server --source exampleSite --themesDir ../.. --disableFastRender"
scripts.build: pnpm css:build && pnpm ts:build && hugo --source exampleSite --themesDir ../.. --gc --minify
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm type-check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:run && pnpm check:templates && pnpm check:warnings && pnpm check:fallbacks && pnpm check:i18n && pnpm check:outputs && pnpm check:vendor && pnpm check:skill
scripts.check:skill: node scripts/gen-skill-shortcodes.js --check && node scripts/gen-skill-fences.js --check && node scripts/gen-skill-landing.js --check && node scripts/gen-skill-data.js --check && node scripts/gen-skill-params.js --check && node scripts/check-skill-counts.js
scripts.gen:skill: node scripts/gen-skill-shortcodes.js && node scripts/gen-skill-fences.js && node scripts/gen-skill-landing.js && node scripts/gen-skill-data.js && node scripts/gen-skill-params.js
